import sys
from heapq import heappop, heappush


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    pos = 0
    t = int(data[pos]); pos += 1
    out = []
    for _ in range(t):
        n, budget = int(data[pos]), int(data[pos + 1]); pos += 2
        parent = [0] * (n + 1)
        leader = [0] * (n + 1)
        heaps = [None] * (n + 1)  # max-heaps stored as negated costs
        total = [0] * (n + 1)
        for i in range(1, n + 1):
            parent[i] = int(data[pos])
            cost = int(data[pos + 1])
            leader[i] = int(data[pos + 2])
            pos += 3
            heaps[i] = [-cost]
            total[i] = cost
        best = 0
        # R[i] < i, so children are finished before their parent
        for v in range(n, 0, -1):
            h = heaps[v]
            while total[v] > budget:
                total[v] += heappop(h)
            best = max(best, leader[v] * len(h))
            p = parent[v]
            if p:
                # merge the smaller heap into the larger one
                if len(heaps[p]) < len(h):
                    heaps[p], heaps[v] = h, heaps[p]
                    total[p], total[v] = total[v], total[p]
                large = heaps[p]
                for c in heaps[v]:
                    heappush(large, c)
                total[p] += total[v]
                heaps[v] = None
        out.append(str(best))
    print("\n".join(out))


main()
